brand.purpose: Chelsea Market is reserved for the top-left homelab brand only.

display.purpose: Screen title only; compact and fixed, never hero scale.

body.purpose: Readable dashboard copy, project names, alert messages, and summaries.

label.purpose: Status labels, timestamps, command text, paths, IDs, and compact metadata.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Reserved for hover, focus, and state feedback.

components.name: Command Bar
components.description: Terminal-inspired scan command and last-sweep status header.
components.css: .ds-command-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; background: #101820; color: #E6EDF3; border: 1px solid #253240; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-command-bar code, .ds-prompt, .ds-sweep { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-prompt { color: #38D9F5; font-weight: 800; } .ds-command-bar code { color: #8B98A5; } .ds-sweep { color: #E6EDF3; background: #15212B; border: 1px solid #253240; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Active Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Selected route state for the dark sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item-active { display: block; color: #E6EDF3; background: #15212B; border: 1px solid #253240; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 700 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38D9F5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Critical Status Pill
components.description: Semantic critical health label with color and text.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid currentColor; padding: 5px 10px; font: 800 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; } .ds-status-pill-critical { color: #F87171; background: #3A171D; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Flat dark bordered surface for dashboard sections.
components.html:
Projects needing attention

homelab projects --watch

Disk usage crossed 90% on Primary VPS.
components.css: .ds-panel-card { background: #101820; color: #E6EDF3; border: 1px solid #253240; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-panel-card header { background: #15212B; border-bottom: 1px solid #253240; padding: 14px 16px; } .ds-panel-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 800; } .ds-panel-card code { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: #5E6B78; font-size: 12px; } .ds-panel-card p { margin: 0; padding: 16px; color: #8B98A5; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.43; }

components.name: Metric Tile
components.description: Compact console metric tile for health counts.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { background: #101820; color: #E6EDF3; border: 1px solid #253240; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-metric-card span { display: block; color: #8B98A5; font: 800 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-metric-card strong { display: block; margin-top: 9px; font: 800 30px/1.1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; } .ds-metric-card small { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: #5E6B78; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Timeline Row
components.description: Terminal-log timeline row with time and event type columns.
components.css: .ds-timeline-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #1D2A36; background: #101820; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-timeline-row time { width: 64px; color: #5E6B78; font: 800 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; } .ds-timeline-row code { min-width: 78px; color: #38D9F5; font: 800 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; } .ds-timeline-row div { flex: 1; min-width: 220px; } .ds-timeline-row strong { display: block; color: #E6EDF3; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-timeline-row p { margin: 3px 0 0; color: #8B98A5; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.43; }

narrative.overview: homelab should feel like a private technical console for a solo developer who checks it between deploys, cron runs, and server chores. The system is minimal, compact, and task-first: a mostly dark charcoal workspace, terminal-like command framing, and clear status rows make it feel native to a developer workstation without drifting into novelty.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained product UI with mostly dark charcoal surfaces and precise hairline borders.
A Chelsea Market wordmark limited to the sidebar brand.
Monospace accents for paths, commands, timestamps, IDs, and status metadata.
Flat dark surfaces with tonal separation instead of decorative shadows.
Semantic health color paired with explicit labels.
Dense but calm layouts that keep current problems easy to find.

rules.name: The Quiet Until Broken Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces carry most of the interface. Health colors appear only where they communicate actual state.

rules.name: The No Marketing Blue Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce default SaaS blues for primary actions or charts. homelab's visual identity is charcoal, cyan, and restrained semantic state color.

rules.name: The Wordmark Exception Rule
rules.body: Chelsea Market is reserved for the homelab wordmark. Use sans for UI structure and monospace only where developer-console metadata earns it.

dos: Do keep the default screen mostly dark and neutral: Console Background, Panel Charcoal, Raised Panel, and sparse Terminal Cyan.
Do use exact status labels with semantic colors for every health state.
Do keep card corners at 8px and status pills at 999px.
Do use flat 1px borders and internal dividers for structure.
Do preserve density where it helps solo developers scan current health quickly.
donts: Don't make this look like a marketing site, SaaS landing page, public status-page brochure, enterprise observability command center, or neon terminal cosplay.
Don't add oversized hero sections, decorative metrics, over-styled dashboard chrome, playful branding, heavy gradients, or dense visual noise.
Don't introduce gradient text, glassmorphism, wide drop shadows, or 32px-plus card radii.
Don't use color without a label for health or alert state.
Don't turn terminal/developer theming into novelty: no Matrix rain, fake hacker decoration, or unreadable green-on-black cosplay.
